content.value_statement: Founders often face decisions with incomplete evidence and competing priorities. AI Phill guides structured reflection through questions, risk framing, scenario exploration, and values checks.
actual_capabilities: Guides founders through Socratic questions for major decisions.
Surfaces blind spots such as optimism bias and sunk cost bias.
Builds structured risk assessments with mitigation and contingency ideas.
Models best, likely, worst, and rare scenario paths.
Checks decisions against founder values and long-term goals.
Provides reusable prompts for strategic planning conversations.
limitations: Does not make final business decisions for the user.
Does not provide live market or competitor data by itself.
Requires accurate founder context to produce useful analysis.
Not a substitute for legal, financial, tax, or board advice.

use_cases.title: Choose a Funding Path
use_cases.description: Compare raising capital, bootstrapping, or using debt against runway, control, growth goals, and personal trade-offs.

use_cases.title: Stress-Test a Hiring Plan
use_cases.description: Identify process, training, culture, burn rate, and customer risks before expanding a key team.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a Product Pivot
use_cases.description: Separate customer evidence from frustration, clarify opportunity cost, and define signals for the next direction.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a founder who needs structure before choosing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me think through whether to choose this decision: [decision]. My context is [context]. Ask clarifying questions before giving a framework.

prompt_templates.title: Test an Assumption
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for checking evidence and hidden weaknesses.
prompt_templates.prompt: Challenge this assumption: [assumption]. Here is my evidence: [evidence]. Identify weak points and questions I should answer next.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Risk Mitigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for risk, mitigation, and contingency planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the risks of [decision] over [timeframe]. Estimate probability and impact, then suggest mitigation and contingency steps.

prompt_templates.title: Run Deep Scenario Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for comparing several strategic options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use extended thinking to compare [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Include values alignment, second-order effects, and decision triggers.

output_examples.input: Should we raise a Series A or keep bootstrapping?
output_examples.output: AI Phill asks about five-year vision, product-market fit, runway, control, investor pressure, and personal trade-offs before comparing paths.

output_examples.input: Test my assumption that first-mover advantage will protect us.
output_examples.output: AI Phill probes evidence, follower risk, switching costs, market dynamics, and what data would prove the assumption wrong.

output_examples.input: Assess the risk of doubling the sales team this quarter.
output_examples.output: AI Phill separates sales process, training, churn, burn rate, and culture risks, then suggests phased hiring and contingency triggers.

best_practices: Share decision context, constraints, evidence, and time horizon.
Use the questions to gather data before choosing a path.
Revisit major decisions after emotions settle and new evidence arrives.
anti_patterns: Asking for a final answer without sharing trade-offs or goals.
Treating speculative scenarios as forecasts or guaranteed outcomes.
Using the skill instead of qualified legal, financial, or tax advice.

faq.question: Can AI Phill make decisions for me?
faq.answer: No. It helps you reason through decisions and keeps the final choice with you.

faq.question: Does it replace advisors or board members?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare questions and frameworks, but human advisors remain important.

faq.question: Can it support fundraising decisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare fundraising, bootstrapping, debt, timing, readiness, and investor trade-offs.

faq.question: Does it need private company data?
faq.answer: Only share the context needed for analysis. Avoid unnecessary sensitive data.

faq.question: Can it use Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What makes this skill useful for founders?
faq.answer: It combines Socratic prompts, risk checks, scenario analysis, and values alignment in one decision workflow.
